notes.title: Patch Notes v2.2.0
notes.notes:
Patch Notes v2.2.0



New!

You can now choose the starting tile wall.

A new game mode is planned for the next update.
Stay tuned!

notes.title: Patch Notes v2.1.0
notes.notes:
Patch Notes v2.1.0

New!

Global Rankings Are Here!
The Steam Global Rankings feature has been implemented.
The highest han count achieved in Advanced Mode from now on will be recorded in the global rankings.
Records from before this implementation will not be reflected in the rankings.

How to View the Rankings:
Click "Global Rankings" from "Best Score" to view the rankings in the in-game browser.
The rankings will record the highest han count per Steam account.

notes.title: Patch Notes v2.0.5

Patch Notes v2.0.5

notes.title: Patch Notes v2.0.4

**BUGFIX**

- Fixed an issue with overlapping UI.

notes.title: Patch Notes v2.0.3
notes.notes:
Patch Notes v2.0.3

- Adjusted parts of the "Yaku Table."
- Other UI fixes.

**BUGFIX**

- Corrected "Self-pick" to be a lower-ranking yaku under "Blessing of Heaven."
- Fixed "Blooming of the Five Circles," "Grasping the Moon," and "Scooping Fish" so they no longer level up.
- God pick: Adjusted module effects and description.
- Blue boost III: Adjusted module description.

notes.title: Patch Notes v2.0.2
notes.notes:
Patch Notes v2.0.2

- Added a display showing the number of acquired modules in the "Statistics."
- The "Yaku Table" and "Module List" can now be accessed from the "Statistics" section of "Best Scores."
- Updated the description of the "Flowers, Birds, Wind, and Moon" yaku to include "Round Wind Tile or Seat Wind Tile" instead of just "Seat Wind Tile."

Bug Fixes

- Fixed an issue where Kan candidate options were displayed incorrectly under certain conditions.
- Corrected the calculation of remaining turns during a mulligan.

notes.title: Update v2.0.1
notes.notes:
**Patch Notes v2.0.1**

- You can now check the remaining wall tiles when selecting modules.

**BUGFIXES**

- Fixed an issue where the "Ultimate Enhancer" achievement could not be unlocked. Players who have already acquired all enhancement modules will unlock the achievement upon enhancing a module again.
- "4Conc Triplets single Wait": Fixed the number conversion.
- "Reset round": Adjusted UI display upon round failure.

notes.title: Update v1.0.2
notes.notes:
Patch Notes v1.0.2

BUGFIXES

- Fixed a bug where some tiles in the wall would disappear under certain conditions when starting a round.
- Fixed a bug with the target score when entering Endless Mode consecutively.
- Fixed a bug related to item stock counts.

Others

- Disabled automatic discard (Tsumo-giri) when discarding from the hand.
- Adjusted the UI.

notes.title: Update v1.0.1
notes.notes:
Patch Notes v1.0.1

- Added "Quality" and "FPS" settings to the options menu.
- Added "How to Play" to the in-game settings.
    - Added the ability to reassign actions other than tile operations to the right-click.
    - Added a feature to display the control guide.

Fixes
- Fixed an issue where "Enable/Disable (Riichi, Pon, Chi, Kan)" and "Reach while Speed" settings in the in-game options would not persist after restarting the game.
- Added "Return to Title" and "New Game" options to the "End" menu in the in-game settings.
- Changed the "Ron" button to "Win"
- Fixed a bug that caused multiple instances of the results screen to appear.
- Other UI adjustments.

Yaku BUGFIX
- Fixed a bug with the head (pair) determination in "Thirteen Orphans".
- Fixed a bug with the round count determination for Double Reach and "Blessing of Heaven".
